article.title: Future videos
article.body:
Some of the best golf ever hit never makes it past a group chat. The flop over a bunker that stopped dead. The behind-the-back chip your buddy swore you couldn't do. If it happened with a Lucky club in your hands, we'd like it to get a bigger audience.

Post it, tag us

Post it on Instagram or TikTok and tag @luckygolfofficial. That's it. We keep an eye on our tags, and the good ones end up on our Community page. We'll always ask before we share anything of yours.

If nobody filmed it, it didn't happen. So film it.

Posting a lot anyway?

Then take a look at the ambassador program. Your best clips can run as ads from your own handle, and you earn a share of what they sell.

Quick answers

How do I get my video featured?

Post it on Instagram or TikTok and tag @luckygolfofficial. If we'd like to share it, we'll ask you first.

Does it have to be a trick shot?

No. A great chip or a whole round in your Lucky gear counts too.

Can I get paid for posting?

If you join the ambassador program, your best clips can run as ads from your own handle and you earn a share of the sales. There's no follower minimum.
